image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a grey whale's head and rostrum emerging vertically from deep blue ocean water. The whale's snout is pointed upwards, breaking the surface with significant splashing and white foam. The skin appears dark grey/black with lighter mottling and barnacle-like textures. The background is uniform blue water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows the ventral side (mouth/throat area) or the very tip of the rostrum pointing up. The dorsal side where blowholes are located is facing away from the camera or submerged/obscured by the angle. Cannot verify blowholes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin clearly shows the characteristic mottled pattern with white/grey speckles consistent with barnacle encrustation found on grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only captures the head/rostrum. The posterior back and dorsal region are completely outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head is visible. The full body shape cannot be assessed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the Head checkpoint; the texture on the visible head matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed or obscured by water/splashes. No baleen plates are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are not visible in this head-only crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The high-resolution texture on the rostrum shows roughness and bumpiness consistent with callosities/barnacles.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white foam/splash has a slightly 'painted' or smudged appearance rather than distinct droplets. It lacks the fine-grained stochastic detail of real high-speed water photography, appearing somewhat like generated noise.
The very tip of the snout appears slightly softened or melted into the background water, lacking a sharp occlusion boundary. This is subtle but suggests minor generation blur.
